test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment In the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

My friend __is owing an expensive cell phone__.

options.text: is own an expensive cell phone

solution:
The correct answer is "**owns an expensive cell phone**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the word "owing"
